evidence.quote: Strain susceptibility in the 2025 PMB + rifampicin thigh study
S26 | DOI 10.1093/jac/dkaf056 | Table 1 (van den Berg et al. 2025)

MIC = median of triplicate CLSI broth microdilution, mg/L. PMB regimens: SC q6h, total daily dose 16, 32, 64 mg/kg (methods); results text also mentions 4, 8, 16 mg/kg (unexplained source inconsistency).
Per-regimen CFU values appear only in Figure 2 (not digitized). PMB exposure in this study is taken from S01 with an assumed 80% binding; no PMB PK was measured.
Extrapolated PMB fAUC/MIC targets reported in the Table 4 footnote are published model-derived results and are kept in the reference file, not here.
